visual.general_description: Two volume-rendered CT images of the neck and upper chest, frontal and lateral, with a cyan airway overlay on a gray skeleton.
visual.detailed_description: Panel a (left) and panel b (right) are labeled with lowercase letters on a gray background. Each shows a gray semi-transparent skeleton of the neck and upper chest with the airway highlighted in cyan. In panel a the airway descends from the neck and bends away from the midline before branching into the main bronchi; in panel b the airway curves sharply across the image from the neck toward the lower chest. No scale, numbers or other text are printed.

panels.general_description: Frontal volume-rendered CT view of the neck and upper chest with the airway highlighted in cyan.
panels.detailed_description: A cyan-colored semi-transparent airway rendering sits over a gray semi-transparent rendering of the skeleton in frontal orientation: the upper airway/larynx region at the cervical spine, then a narrow tube running downward and then to the lower right of the image, ending in a branching structure at the lower left and lower right that resembles the main bronchi. Ribs fan out on both sides and the clavicle/shoulder region is visible at the top corners. The tube does not follow a straight midline course. No text, labels, arrows or measurement lines are visible.
